lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak mai atul sukh paaiaa janam maran bhai laathe ||2||20||43||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have found immeasurable peace; my fear of birth and death is gone. ||2||20||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਆਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: re mooRhe aan kaahe kat jaaee ||
lines.translation: You fool: why are you going somewhere else?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g manohar a(n)mrit hai re bhool bhool bikh khaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Enticing Ambrosial Amrit is with you, but you are deluded, totally deluded, and you eat poison. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh su(n)dar chatur anoop bidhaate tis siu ruch nahee raaee ||
lines.translation: God is Beautiful, Wise and Incomparable; He is the Creator, the Architect of Destiny, but you have no love for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਵਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mohan siu baavar man mohio jhooth thagauree paaee ||1||
lines.translation: The mad-man's mind is enticed by Maya, the enticer; he has taken the intoxicating drug of falsehood. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio daiaal kripaal dukh harataa sa(n)tan siu ban aaee ||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of pain has become kind and compassionate to me, and I am in tune with the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: sagal nidhaan gharai mahi paae kahu naanak jot samaaee ||2||21||44||
lines.translation: I have obtained all treasures within the home of my own heart; says Nanak, my light has merged into the Light. ||2||21||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਪਹਿਲਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n) pri preet cheet pahilareeaa ||
lines.translation: My consciousness has loved my Beloved God, since the very beginning of time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tau bachan deeo mere satigur tau mai saaj seegareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When You blessed me with the Teachings, O my True Guru, I was embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਅਭੂਲਾ ਹਮ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham bhoolah tum sadaa abhoolaa ham patit tum patit udhareeaa ||
lines.translation: I am mistaken; You are never mistaken. I am a sinner; You are the Saving Grace of sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਲਾਜ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham neech birakh tum mailaagar laaj sa(n)g sa(n)g basareeaa ||1||
lines.translation: I am a lowly thorn-tree, and You are the sandalwood tree. Please preserve my honor by staying with me; please stay with me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੰਤਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum ga(n)bheer dheer upakaaree ham kiaa bapure ja(n)tareeaa ||
lines.translation: You are deep and profound, calm and benevolent. What am I? Just a poor helpless being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਤਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੂਖਿ ਸੇਜਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur kripaal naanak har melio tau meree sookh sejareeaa ||2||22||45||
lines.translation: The Merciful Guru Nanak has united me with the Lord. I lay on His Bed of Peace. ||2||22||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਓਇ ਦਿਨਸ ਧੰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: man oi dinas dha(n)n paravaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: O my mind, blessed and approved is that day,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਤੇ ਘਰੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal te gharee sa(n)jog suhaave satigur sa(n)g giaanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and fruitful is that hour, and lucky is that moment, when the True Guru blesses me with spirtual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਗ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n subhaag dha(n)n sohaagaa dha(n)n det jin maanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Blessed is my good destiny, and blessed is my Husband Lord. Blessed are those upon whom honor is bestowed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਹੀਂਉ ਕੀਓ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan tumhraa sabh grihu dhan tumaraa hee(n)u keeo kurabaanaa(n) ||1||
lines.translation: This body is Yours, all my home and wealth are Yours; I offer my heart as a sacrifice to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪੇਖਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot laakh raaj sukh paae ik nimakh pekh drisataanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: I obtain tens of thousands and millions of regal pleasures, if I gaze upon Your Blessed Vision, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਹ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: jau kahahu mukhahu sevak ih baiseeai sukh naanak a(n)t na jaanaa(n) ||2||23||46||
lines.translation: When You, O God, say, "My servant, stay here with me", Nanak knows unlimited peace. ||2||23||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab moro sahasaa dookh gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Now I am rid of my skepticism and sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aur upaav sagal tiaag chhode satigur saran paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have abandoned and forsaken all other efforts, and come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਰੇ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਖਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sidh kaaraj sabh savare aha(n) rog sagal hee khaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have attained total perfection, and all my works are perfectly completed; the illness of egotism has been totally eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਉ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot paraadh khin mahi khau bhaee hai gur mil har har kahiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Millions of sins are destroyed in an instant; meeting with the Guru, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦਾਸ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch daas gur vasagat keene man nihachal nirabhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Subduing the five thieves, he Guru has made them my slaves; my mind has become stable and steady and fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਡੋਲੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: aai na jaavai na kat hee dolai thir naanak raajaiaa ||2||24||47||
lines.translation: It does not come or go in reincarnation; it does not waver or wander anywhere. O Nanak, my empire is eternal. ||2||24||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh mero it ut sadaa sahaaee ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, God is forever my Help and Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamohan mere jee ko piaaro kavan kahaa gun gaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Enticer of my mind, the Beloved of my soul. What Glorious Praises of His can I sing and chant? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਿ ਖਿਲਾਇ ਲਾਡ ਲਾਡਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khel khilaai laad laadaavai sadaa sadaa anadaaee ||
lines.translation: He plays with me, He fondles and caresses me. Forever and ever, He blesses me with bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaalai baarik kee niaaee jaise maat pitaaee ||1||
lines.translation: He cherishes me, like the father and the mother love their child. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin nimakh nahee rahi sakeeai bisar na kabahoo jaaee ||
lines.translation: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant; I shall never forget Him.
